literature.headline_zh: 人腺病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期人腺病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 2013-2023年间,HAdV-4是最常见的类型(n = 446;89.7%),其次是HAdV-3(n = 25;5%)、HAdV-21(n = 11;2.2%)、HAdV-7(n = 6;1.2%)和HAdV-11(n = 1;0.2%)。2024年2月至2025年6月期间,在1133个样本(67%)中检测到HAdV-4,在440个样本(26%)中检测到HAdV-7,在70个样本(4.1%)中同时检测到HAdV-4和‐7,在1个样本(0.1%)中同时检测到HAdV-14。 [10.1111/irv.70329]
转基因小鼠在病毒感染后表现出剂量依赖性的体重减轻、肺组织中强烈的病毒复制以及特征性的组织病理学变化。疫苗接种诱导了强烈的HAdV-55特异性IgG和中和抗体反应,接种疫苗的小鼠与对照组相比表现出更少的体重减轻和更快的恢复速度。 [10.71150/jm.2605005]

三个持续下调的基因(EPB42、RUNDC3A 和 ASCC2)被确定为 KD 的候选诊断生物标志物。三基因模型在发现 队列研究 中的 AUC 为 0.903,在独立 GSE68004 队列研究 中的 AUC 为 0.948。在临床相关发热对照中,该模型显示 KD 和 人腺病毒 感染 (AUC = 0.830) 以及 KD 和 A 组链球菌感染 (AUC = 0.769) 之间有中等程度的区分。 [10.1007/s10067-026-08453-9]
一些儿科 BALF 文库在 HAdV-B 相关的代表性重叠群中显示出广泛的读取覆盖率,而成人文库和环境对照主要显示出低覆盖广度信号。 [10.3389/fpubh.2026.1961482]

HAdV was detected year-round with marked seasonal variation ( P < 0.001) and a clear peak in winter (13.4%, 573/4,285). The detection rate was significantly higher in males than in females ( P = 0.002). [10.1186/s12879-026-14452-7]
The transgenic mice showed dose-dependent weight loss, robust viral replication in lung tissues, and characteristic histopathological changes following viral challenge. [10.71150/jm.2605005]

Three consistently downregulated genes (EPB42, RUNDC3A, and ASCC2) were identified as candidate diagnostic biomarkers for KD. The three-gene model achieved an AUC of 0.903 in the discovery cohort and 0.948 in the independent GSE68004 cohort. [10.1007/s10067-026-08453-9]

Several pediatric BALF libraries showed broad read coverage across the HAdV-B-related representative contig, whereas adult libraries and environmental controls mainly showed low-coverage-breadth signals. [10.3389/fpubh.2026.1961482]

papers.title: Molecular Characterization of Human Adenoviruses Before and After a Severe HAdV‐7 Military Outbreak in Finland in 2024
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background In 2024, a severe outbreak caused by human adenovirus type 7d (HAdV‐7) occurred in Finnish military garrisons. Molecular typing was implemented to support outbreak control. The aim of this study was to determine adenovirus types circulating in Finnish garrisons during 2013–2023 by retrospective surveillance and to review earlier findings to better understand factors contributing to the 2024 outbreak. Methods Adenovirus‐positive respiratory samples collected through routine surveillance (2013–2023) and enhanced surveillance (2024–2025) were typed using type‐specific PCR assays targeting types 3, 4, 7, 11, 14, 16, and 21. Whole‐genome sequencing was performed on 11 selected samples. Index case interviews were conducted among conscripts infected with HAdV‐7 in late 2023. Results During 2013–2023, among 497 typed samples, HAdV‐4 was most common ( n = 446; 89.7%), followed by HAdV‐3 ( n = 25; 5%). Other types detected were HAdV‐21 ( n = 11; 2.2%), HAdV‐7 ( n = 6; 1.2%), and HAdV‐11 ( n = 1; 0.2%). HAdV‐4 was predominant in 2013–2017 and HAdV‐3 in 2018–2019. Between February 2024 and June 2025, 1692 adenovirus‐positive respiratory samples were typed. The adenovirus types detected were HAdV‐4 ( n = 1133; 67%), HAdV‐7 ( n = 440; 26%), co‐detection of HAdV‐4 and ‐7 ( n = 70; 4.1%), and HAdV‐14 ( n = 1; 0.1%). Epidemiological investigation and whole‐genome sequencing data revealed that the adenovirus associated with the 2024 outbreak (HAdV‐7d) was already circulating in Finnish garrisons in 2023. Conclusion The severity of the 2024 outbreak may reflect limited prior circulation of HAdV‐7 in Finland. Although HAdV‐7 continued to circulate among conscripts in 2025, the severity of the epidemic subsided, possibly due to effective preventative measures guided by active surveillance.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand factors contributing to a severe HAdV‐7 outbreak in Finnish military garrisons in 2024 by reviewing adenovirus types circulating before the outbreak.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was a retrospective surveillance of adenovirus‐positive respiratory samples collected from 2013 to 2023 and enhanced surveillance from 2024 to 2025 in Finnish garrisons. A total of 497 samples were typed during the initial period, and 1692 samples were typed during the outbreak period.
analysis.methods: Adenovirus types were identified using type‐specific PCR assays targeting specific strains, and whole‐genome sequencing was performed on 11 selected samples to analyze the outbreak-associated HAdV‐7d strain.
analysis.main_results: During 2013–2023, HAdV‐4 was the most common type (n = 446; 89.7%), followed by HAdV‐3 (n = 25; 5%), HAdV‐21 (n = 11; 2.2%), HAdV‐7 (n = 6; 1.2%), and HAdV‐11 (n = 1; 0.2%). Between February 2024 and June 2025, HAdV‐4 was detected in 1133 samples (67%), HAdV‐7 in 440 samples (26%), with co-detection of HAdV‐4 and ‐7 in 70 samples (4.1%) and HAdV‐14 in 1 sample (0.1%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that HAdV‐7d, the virus associated with the 2024 outbreak, was already circulating in Finnish garrisons in 2023, suggesting that limited prior circulation may have contributed to the outbreak's severity.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the importance of active surveillance in tracking adenovirus circulation and inform the development of targeted preventative measures to mitigate future outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on surveillance data and does not include direct causal evidence, but the results are supported by whole‐genome sequencing and epidemiological investigation, providing moderate confidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the molecular characterization of human adenoviruses in Finnish military garrisons before and after a severe HAdV‐7 outbreak in 2024. Retrospective surveillance from 2013–2023 revealed HAdV‐4 as the most common type, followed by HAdV‐3, HAdV‐21, HAdV‐7, and HAdV‐11. Enhanced surveillance from 2024–2025 showed a shift in prevalence, with HAdV‐7 becoming dominant. Whole-genome sequencing confirmed that the outbreak strain, HAdV‐7d, had been circulating since 2023. The authors suggest that the outbreak's severity may be due to limited prior circulation of HAdV‐7 in Finland. The study underscores the value of active surveillance in understanding adenovirus dynamics and implementing effective prevention strategies.

papers.title_zh: 2024 年芬兰严重 HAdV-7 军事 暴发 前后 人腺病毒 的分子表征
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Background In 2024, a severe outbreak caused by human adenovirus type 7d (HAdV‐7) occurred in Finnish military garrisons. Molecular typing was implemented to support outbreak control. The aim of this study was to determine adenovirus types circulating in Finnish garrisons during 2013–2023 by retrospective surveillance and to review earlier findings to better understand factors contributing to the 2024 outbreak. Methods Adenovirus‐positive respiratory samples collected through routine surveillance (2013–2023) and enhanced surveillance (2024–2025) were typed using type‐specific PCR assays targeting types 3, 4, 7, 11, 14, 16, and 21. Whole‐genome sequencing was performed on 11 selected samples. Index case interviews were conducted among conscripts infected with HAdV‐7 in late 2023. Results During 2013–2023, among 497 typed samples, HAdV‐4 was most common ( n = 446; 89.7%), followed by HAdV‐3 ( n = 25; 5%). Other types detected were HAdV‐21 ( n = 11; 2.2%), HAdV‐7 ( n = 6; 1.2%), and HAdV‐11 ( n = 1; 0.2%). HAdV‐4 was predominant in 2013–2017 and HAdV‐3 in 2018–2019. Between February 2024 and June 2025, 1692 adenovirus‐positive respiratory samples were typed. The adenovirus types detected were HAdV‐4 ( n = 1133; 67%), HAdV‐7 ( n = 440; 26%), co‐detection of HAdV‐4 and ‐7 ( n = 70; 4.1%), and HAdV‐14 ( n = 1; 0.1%). Epidemiological investigation and whole‐genome sequencing data revealed that the adenovirus associated with the 2024 outbreak (HAdV‐7d) was already circulating in Finnish garrisons in 2023. Conclusion The severity of the 2024 outbreak may reflect limited prior circulation of HAdV‐7 in Finland. Although HAdV‐7 continued to circulate among conscripts in 2025, the severity of the epidemic subsided, possibly due to effective preventative measures guided by active surveillance.

papers.title: A comprehensive analysis of molecular epidemiology and clinical characteristics of human adenovirus among hospitalized children with pneumonia in Tianjin, China, 2022–2025
papers.abstract: Human adenoviruse (HAdV) is a major pathogen associated with acute respiratory infections (ARIs) in children worldwide. However, the epidemiological and genotypic characteristics of HAdV among pediatric inpatients with ARIs have not been fully elucidated in Tianjin. Therefore, this study aimed to examine the epidemiological features, genotype distribution, and clinical associations of HAdV infection in this population. Respiratory specimens were collected from children hospitalized with ARIs between September 2022 and August 2025. Targeted next-generation sequencing was used for initial screening and typing of HAdV. Randomly selected positive samples were further analyzed by conventional PCR amplification targeting the hexon gene, followed by phylogenetic analysis using reference sequences from GenBank. A total of 19,523 specimens were tested, yielding an overall HAdV detection rate of 8.7% (1,704/19,523). The detection rate was significantly higher in males than in females ( P = 0.002). Significant differences were observed across age groups ( P < 0.001), with the highest detection rate in the 3–6 years age group (11.9%, 551/4,611). Notably, genotype composition also differed significantly by age ( P < 0.001): preschool and school-aged children were mainly infected with HAdV-3 and HAdV-7, whereas infants and toddlers were predominantly infected with HAdV-3 and HAdV-1. HAdV was detected year-round with marked seasonal variation ( P < 0.001) and a clear peak in winter (13.4%, 573/4,285). Temporal analysis revealed a shift in predominant species: HAdV-C was dominant before August 2023, while HAdV-B became predominant thereafter. Seasonally, HAdV-B (particularly HAdV-3 and HAdV-7) was predominant in winter, whereas HAdV-C (particularly HAdV-1) was more common in summer ( P < 0.001). Among 1,447 successfully genotyped samples, 14 genotypes belonging to five HAdV species (A, B, C, E, and F) were identified. The predominant genotypes were HAdV-3 (51.5%, 745/1,447) and HAdV-7 (18.4%, 266/1,447), followed by HAdV-1 (12.2%, 177/1,447), HAdV-2 (6.6%, 95/1,447), HAdV-21 (6.3%, 91/1,447), HAdV-5 (2.4%, 35/1,447), HAdV-4 (1.3%, 19/1,447), and other genotypes (1.3%, 19/1,447). The main clinical diagnoses included pneumonia, bronchitis, tonsillopharyngitis, and upper respiratory tract infections (URTIs). Genotype–phenotype association analysis revealed that HAdV-3 and HAdV-7 were predominant in pneumonia cases, whereas HAdV-3 and HAdV-1 were common in tonsillopharyngitis and URTIs. Importantly, children infected with HAdV-7 were more likely to develop severe pneumonia ( P < 0.001). HAdV-3, HAdV-7 and HAdV-1 were the dominant circulating genotypes among hospitalized children with ARIs in Tianjin from 2022 to 2025. A higher detection rate was observed among male toddlers, with a winter peak. Age-specific, seasonal, and inter-annual shifts in genotype distribution were observed, with HAdV-B replacing HAdV-C as the dominant species after August 2023. These findings support region specific surveillance and targeted interventions, and provide epidemiological evidence to inform the rational design and formulation of multivalent vaccines against pediatric HAdV.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 人腺病毒 (HAdV) 是与全世界儿童急性呼吸道感染 (ARIs) 相关的主要病原体。然而,天津市儿童急性呼吸道感染住院患者HAdV的流行病学和基因型特征尚未完全阐明。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 呼吸道标本采集自2022年9月至2025年8月因急性呼吸道感染住院的儿童。主要临床诊断包括肺炎、支气管炎、扁桃体咽炎和上呼吸道感染(URTI)。HAdV-3、HAdV-7和HAdV-1是2022年至2025年天津市急性呼吸道感染住院儿童的主要流行基因型。
elements_zh.methods: 靶向下一代测序用于 HAdV 的初步筛选和分型。随机选择的阳性样本通过针对六邻体基因的常规 PCR 扩增进一步分析,然后使用 GenBank 的参考序列进行系统发育分析。总共检测了 19,523 个样本,HAdV 总体检出率为 8.7%(1,704/19,523)。
elements_zh.main_results: HAdV 全年均有检测,季节性变化明显(P < 0.001),冬季出现明显高峰(13.4%,573/4,285)。男性检出率显着高于女性(P=0.002)。不同年龄组之间存在显着差异(P < 0.001),其中3-6岁组检出率最高(11.9%,551/4,611)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 基因型-表型关联分析显示,HAdV-3 和 HAdV-7 在肺炎病例中占主导地位,而 HAdV-3 和 HAdV-1 在扁桃体咽炎和上呼吸道感染中常见。重要的是,感染 HAdV-7 的儿童更容易患上重症肺炎 (P < 0.001)。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些研究结果支持针对特定区域的 监测 和有针对性的干预措施,并提供流行病学证据,为针对儿科 HAdV 的多价 疫苗 的合理设计和配制提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 观察到基因型分布的年龄特异性、季节性和年际变化,2023 年 8 月后 HAdV-B 取代 HAdV-C 成为优势种。所提供的证据并未报告研究设计的局限性。

papers.title_zh: 2022-2025年中国天津市住院肺炎患儿分子流行病学及人腺病毒临床特征综合分析
papers.source_body_en: Human adenoviruse (HAdV) is a major pathogen associated with acute respiratory infections (ARIs) in children worldwide. However, the epidemiological and genotypic characteristics of HAdV among pediatric inpatients with ARIs have not been fully elucidated in Tianjin. Therefore, this study aimed to examine the epidemiological features, genotype distribution, and clinical associations of HAdV infection in this population. Respiratory specimens were collected from children hospitalized with ARIs between September 2022 and August 2025. Targeted next-generation sequencing was used for initial screening and typing of HAdV. Randomly selected positive samples were further analyzed by conventional PCR amplification targeting the hexon gene, followed by phylogenetic analysis using reference sequences from GenBank. A total of 19,523 specimens were tested, yielding an overall HAdV detection rate of 8.7% (1,704/19,523). The detection rate was significantly higher in males than in females ( P = 0.002). Significant differences were observed across age groups ( P < 0.001), with the highest detection rate in the 3–6 years age group (11.9%, 551/4,611). Notably, genotype composition also differed significantly by age ( P < 0.001): preschool and school-aged children were mainly infected with HAdV-3 and HAdV-7, whereas infants and toddlers were predominantly infected with HAdV-3 and HAdV-1. HAdV was detected year-round with marked seasonal variation ( P < 0.001) and a clear peak in winter (13.4%, 573/4,285). Temporal analysis revealed a shift in predominant species: HAdV-C was dominant before August 2023, while HAdV-B became predominant thereafter. Seasonally, HAdV-B (particularly HAdV-3 and HAdV-7) was predominant in winter, whereas HAdV-C (particularly HAdV-1) was more common in summer ( P < 0.001). Among 1,447 successfully genotyped samples, 14 genotypes belonging to five HAdV species (A, B, C, E, and F) were identified. The predominant genotypes were HAdV-3 (51.5%, 745/1,447) and HAdV-7 (18.4%, 266/1,447), followed by HAdV-1 (12.2%, 177/1,447), HAdV-2 (6.6%, 95/1,447), HAdV-21 (6.3%, 91/1,447), HAdV-5 (2.4%, 35/1,447), HAdV-4 (1.3%, 19/1,447), and other genotypes (1.3%, 19/1,447). The main clinical diagnoses included pneumonia, bronchitis, tonsillopharyngitis, and upper respiratory tract infections (URTIs). Genotype–phenotype association analysis revealed that HAdV-3 and HAdV-7 were predominant in pneumonia cases, whereas HAdV-3 and HAdV-1 were common in tonsillopharyngitis and URTIs. Importantly, children infected with HAdV-7 were more likely to develop severe pneumonia ( P < 0.001). HAdV-3, HAdV-7 and HAdV-1 were the dominant circulating genotypes among hospitalized children with ARIs in Tianjin from 2022 to 2025. A higher detection rate was observed among male toddlers, with a winter peak. Age-specific, seasonal, and inter-annual shifts in genotype distribution were observed, with HAdV-B replacing HAdV-C as the dominant species after August 2023. These findings support region specific surveillance and targeted interventions, and provide epidemiological evidence to inform the rational design and formulation of multivalent vaccines against pediatric HAdV.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类腺病毒(HAdV)是与全世界儿童急性呼吸道感染(ARIs)相关的主要病原体。然而,天津市儿童急性呼吸道感染住院患者HAdV的流行病学和基因型特征尚未完全阐明。因此,本研究旨在探讨该人群中HAdV感染的流行病学特征、基因型分布和临床关联。呼吸道标本采集自 2022 年 9 月至 2025 年 8 月期间因急性呼吸道感染住院的儿童。使用靶向下一代测序对 HAdV 进行初步筛查和分型。随机选择的阳性样本通过针对六邻体基因的常规 PCR 扩增进一步分析,然后使用 GenBank 的参考序列进行系统发育分析。总共检测了 19,523 个样本,HAdV 总体检出率为 8.7%(1,704/19,523)。男性检出率显着高于女性(P=0.002)。不同年龄组之间存在显着差异(P < 0.001),其中3-6岁组检出率最高(11.9%,551/4,611)。值得注意的是,基因型组成也因年龄而存在显着差异(P<0.001):学龄前和学龄儿童主要感染HAdV-3和HAdV-7,而婴幼儿主要感染HAdV-3和HAdV-1。HAdV 全年均有检测,季节性变化明显(P < 0.001),冬季出现明显高峰(13.4%,573/4,285)。时间分析揭示了优势物种的变化:HAdV-C 在 2023 年 8 月之前占优势,而 HAdV-B 此后成为优势。从季节上看,HAdV-B(特别是HAdV-3和HAdV-7)在冬季占主导地位,而HAdV-C(特别是HAdV-1)在夏季更常见(P < 0.001)。在 1,447 个成功进行基因分型的样本中,鉴定出了属于 5 个 HAdV 物种(A、B、C、E 和 F)的 14 种基因型。主要基因型为 HAdV-3 (51.5%,745/1,447) 和 HAdV-7 (18.4%,266/1,447),其次是 HAdV-1 (12.2%,177/1,447)、HAdV-2 (6.6%,95/1,447)、HAdV-21 (6.3%,91/1,447)、HAdV-5 (2.4%,35/1,447)、HAdV-4 (1.3%,19/1,447) 和其他基因型 (1.3%,19/1,447)。主要临床诊断包括肺炎、支气管炎、扁桃体咽炎和上呼吸道感染(URTI)。基因型-表型关联分析显示,HAdV-3 和 HAdV-7 在肺炎病例中占主导地位,而 HAdV-3 和 HAdV-1 在扁桃体咽炎和上呼吸道感染中常见。重要的是,感染 HAdV-7 的儿童更容易患上重症肺炎 (P < 0.001)。HAdV-3、HAdV-7和HAdV-1是2022年至2025年天津市急性呼吸道感染住院儿童的主要流行基因型,其中男性幼儿检出率较高,且以冬季为高峰。观察到基因型分布的年龄特异性、季节性和年际变化,2023年8月后HAdV-B取代HAdV-C成为优势种。这些发现支持区域特异性监测和有针对性的干预措施,并提供流行病学证据,为合理设计和配制针对儿童HAdV的多价疫苗提供信息。

papers.title: Establishment of a CD46 and desmoglein-2 expressing mouse model for human adenovirus type 55 vaccine evaluation
papers.abstract: Human adenovirus type 55 (HAdV-55) is an emerging respiratory pathogen associated with severe pneumonia, for which no licensed vaccines are currently available. The lack of physiologically relevant small-animal models has limited preclinical evaluation of vaccine candidates. In this study, we generated a transgenic mouse model co-expressing human CD46 and desmoglein-2 (DSG-2), key entry receptors for HAdV-55, and evaluated its utility for vaccine efficacy testing. A bicistronic expression system enabling simultaneous expression of CD46 and DSG-2 was constructed and functionally validated in vitro, demonstrating enhanced susceptibility to HAdV-55 infection. The transgenic mice exhibited dose-dependent weight loss, robust viral replication in lung tissues, and characteristic histopathological changes following intranasal challenge, recapitulating key features of human adenoviral pneumonia. Using this model, we assessed the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of an inactivated HAdV-55 (iHAdV-55) vaccine formulated with alum. Vaccination induced strong HAdV-55-specific IgG and neutralizing antibody responses, which increased over time following prime–boost immunization. Upon viral challenge, vaccinated mice showed significantly reduced weight loss and accelerated recovery compared to controls. Viral load analysis demonstrated effective control of viral replication and clearance in vaccinated animals. Collectively, these findings establish the CD46/DSG-2 transgenic mouse as a physiologically relevant and translationally valuable model for HAdV-55 infection and demonstrate that iHAdV-55 vaccination confers robust humoral immunity and protective efficacy. This platform provides a critical tool for the development and preclinical evaluation of adenovirus-targeted vaccines and therapeutics.

papers.title_zh: 建立一种同时表达CD46和desmoglein-2的人源化小鼠模型用于人腺病毒类型55 疫苗评估
papers.source_body_en: Human adenovirus type 55 (HAdV-55) is an emerging respiratory pathogen associated with severe pneumonia, for which no licensed vaccines are currently available. The lack of physiologically relevant small-animal models has limited preclinical evaluation of vaccine candidates. In this study, we generated a transgenic mouse model co-expressing human CD46 and desmoglein-2 (DSG-2), key entry receptors for HAdV-55, and evaluated its utility for vaccine efficacy testing. A bicistronic expression system enabling simultaneous expression of CD46 and DSG-2 was constructed and functionally validated in vitro, demonstrating enhanced susceptibility to HAdV-55 infection. The transgenic mice exhibited dose-dependent weight loss, robust viral replication in lung tissues, and characteristic histopathological changes following intranasal challenge, recapitulating key features of human adenoviral pneumonia. Using this model, we assessed the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of an inactivated HAdV-55 (iHAdV-55) vaccine formulated with alum. Vaccination induced strong HAdV-55-specific IgG and neutralizing antibody responses, which increased over time following prime–boost immunization. Upon viral challenge, vaccinated mice showed significantly reduced weight loss and accelerated recovery compared to controls. Viral load analysis demonstrated effective control of viral replication and clearance in vaccinated animals. Collectively, these findings establish the CD46/DSG-2 transgenic mouse as a physiologically relevant and translationally valuable model for HAdV-55 infection and demonstrate that iHAdV-55 vaccination confers robust humoral immunity and protective efficacy. This platform provides a critical tool for the development and preclinical evaluation of adenovirus-targeted vaccines and therapeutics.
papers.abstract_zh: 人腺病毒类型55(HAdV-55)是一种新兴的呼吸道病原体,与严重肺炎相关,目前尚无获批的疫苗。由于缺乏生理相关性的小动物模型,限制了对疫苗候选药物的临床前评估。本研究构建了一种同时表达人类CD46和desmoglein-2(DSG-2)的转基因小鼠模型,这两种是HAdV-55的关键进入受体,并评估了其在疫苗功效测试中的应用价值。构建了一个双顺反子表达系统,使CD46和DSG-2能够同时表达,并在体外功能验证中显示出对HAdV-55感染的增强易感性。转基因小鼠在鼻内挑战后表现出剂量依赖性的体重减轻、肺组织中强烈的病毒复制以及特征性的组织病理学变化,再现了人类腺病毒肺炎的关键特征。利用该模型,我们评估了以氢氧化铝为佐剂的灭活HAdV-55(iHAdV-55)疫苗的免疫原性和保护效果。疫苗接种诱导了强烈的HAdV-55特异性IgG和中和抗体反应,且在初次免疫和加强免疫后反应持续增强。在病毒感染后,接种疫苗的小鼠表现出显著减少的体重减轻和更快的恢复速度,与对照组相比。病毒载量分析显示,接种疫苗的小鼠能够有效控制病毒复制并清除病毒。综上所述,这些发现确立了CD46/DSG-2转基因小鼠作为HAdV-55感染的生理相关模型,并表明iHAdV-55 疫苗接种能够诱导强效的体液免疫和保护效果。该平台为腺病毒靶向的疫苗和治疗药物的开发与临床前评估提供了关键工具。

papers.title: Prolonged survival after systemic immune reactivation by aglatimagene besadenovec plus valacyclovir in immune checkpoint inhibitor-refractory non-small cell lung cancer.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer who progress on immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) face limited options and poor survival. Aglatimagene besadenovec (CAN-2409), a replication-defective adenoviral vector encoding herpes simplex virus-thymidine kinase, plus valacyclovir, has been shown to induce immunogenic cell death and systemic immune activation. METHODS: In this open-label, phase 2a clinical trial, 76 patients were enrolled (intention-to-treat population) and 73 received at least one dose of aglatimagene besadenovec (safety population); 46 patients who received two intratumoral aglatimagene besadenovec injections, completed protocol-defined valacyclovir exposure, and underwent a 12-week imaging comprised the evaluable (per-protocol) population. Endpoints included clinical and immunological outcomes. RESULTS: In the 73 patients included in the safety analysis (including patients who did not receive a second injection due to apparent pseudoprogression), median OS was 14.3 months. In the evaluable (per-protocol) population of 46 patients who completed protocol-defined treatment and week-12 imaging, median OS was 24.5 months (95% CI 16.0 to 33.8). Among the 41 evaluable patients in cohort 2, 15 (37%) were alive at ≥24 months and 5 (12%) at ≥40 months. In the 46-patient evaluable population, the objective response rate was 10.9% (5/46; 95% CI 4.7% to 23.0%) and the disease control rate was 71.7% (33/46; 95% CI 57.5% to 82.7%). In the 73 patients included in the safety analysis (including patients who did not receive a second injection due to apparent pseudoprogression) median overall survival was 14.3 months. Exploratory biomarkers demonstrated systemic immune reactivation, including cytotoxic T-cell expansion and regression of uninjected lesions, with stronger signals in non-squamous histology. No grade 4 treatment-related adverse events or treatment-related deaths were reported. Most treatment-related adverse events were grade 1-2; 10/73 patients (13.7%) experienced grade 3 treatment-related adverse events. Six patients discontinued because of adverse events, including two with events considered possibly related to treatment (including ongoing ICI). CONCLUSIONS: In this single-arm phase 2a study, aglatimagene besadenovec plus valacyclovir with ongoing ICI was associated with systemic immune remodeling and encouraging survival. Because comparisons with historical controls are descriptive and vulnerable to selection and other biases, efficacy requires confirmation in a randomized controlled clinical trial, which has been initiated. TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: NCT04495153.

analysis.summary_en: This phase 2a clinical trial evaluated aglatimagene besadenovec, a replication-defective adenoviral vector, in combination with valacyclovir for patients with immune checkpoint inhibitor-refractory non-small cell lung cancer. In the safety population of 73 patients, median OS was 14.3 months. The results indicated an objective response rate of 10.9% and a disease control rate of 71.7%. No grade 4 treatment-related adverse events or deaths were reported, though 13.7% of patients experienced grade 3 events. The authors concluded that the combination was associated with systemic immune remodeling and encouraging survival, though they emphasized the need for randomized trials to confirm efficacy. The study highlights the potential of adenoviral vectors in cancer immunotherapy but acknowledges limitations in the design, such as the lack of a control group and potential biases.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:接受免疫检查点抑制剂(ICIs)治疗后进展的晚期非小细胞肺癌患者面临着有限的选择和较差的生存率。Aglatimagene besadenovec (CAN-2409) 是一种复制缺陷型腺病毒 媒介,编码单纯疱疹病毒胸苷激酶,加上伐昔洛韦,已被证明可诱导免疫原性细胞死亡和全身免疫激活。方法:在这项开放标签、2a 期临床试验中,入组了 76 名患者(意向治疗人群),其中 73 名患者接受了至少一剂 aglatimagene besadenovec(安全人群);接受两次瘤内注射 aglatimagene besadenovec、完成方案定义的伐昔洛韦暴露并接受 12 周影像学检查的 46 名患者构成了可评估(符合方案)人群。终点包括临床和免疫学结果。结果:在纳入安全性分析的 73 名患者中(包括因明显假性进展而未接受第二次注射的患者),中位 OS 为 14.3 个月。在完成方案定义的 治疗 和第 12 周成像的 46 名患者的可评估(符合方案)人群中,中位 OS 为 24.5 个月(95% CI 16.0 至 33.8)。在 队列研究 2 的 41 名可评估患者中,15 名 (37%) 患者存活时间≥24 个月,5 名患者 (12%) 存活时间≥40 个月。在46名患者的可评估人群中,客观缓解率为10.9%(5/46;95% CI 4.7%至23.0%),疾病控制率为71.7%(33/46;95% CI 57.5%至82.7%)。在纳入安全性分析的 73 名患者中(包括因明显假性进展而未接受第二次注射的患者),中位总生存期为 14.3 个月。探索性生物标志物证明了全身免疫再激活,包括细胞毒性 T 细胞扩增和未注射病变的消退,在非鳞状组织学中具有更强的信号。没有报告 4 级 治疗 相关不良事件或 治疗 相关死亡。大多数 治疗 相关不良事件为 1-2 级;10/73 名患者 (13.7%) 经历了 3 级 治疗 相关不良事件。六名患者因不良事件而停药,其中两名患者的事件被认为可能与 治疗 有关(包括正在进行的 ICI)。结论:在这项单组 2a 期研究中,持续 ICI 的阿格拉美尼联合伐昔洛韦与全身免疫重塑和促进生存相关。由于与历史对照的比较是描述性的,并且容易受到选择和其他偏差的影响,因此疗效需要在已经启动的随机对照临床试验中进行确认。试用注册号:NCT04495153。

papers.title: Viral metagenomic characterization of HAdV-B-related signals in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid from pediatric and adult clinical cohorts
papers.abstract: Human adenovirus (HAdV) is an important respiratory virus in children, but sequence-level evidence for HAdV-related signals in lower respiratory tract samples remains limited. In this study, we analyzed metagenomic next-generation sequencing data from 189 bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) libraries from pediatric and adult clinical cohorts, including 30 pediatric and 159 adult patients, together with laboratory environmental controls. MEGAN read-level classification was used to screen for Adenoviridae -related signals. HAdV-related contigs were further reviewed, and a BALF-derived HAdV-B-related representative contig was selected for read recruitment and coverage analysis. Phylogenetic trees were reconstructed using penton base, hexon, and fiber protein sequences. Adenoviridae -classified signals were more apparent in pediatric BALF libraries than in adult BALF libraries or environmental controls. Several pediatric BALF libraries showed broad read coverage across the HAdV-B-related representative contig, whereas adult libraries and environmental controls mainly showed low-coverage-breadth signals. Phylogenetic analysis placed BALF-derived penton base, hexon, and fiber sequences within HAdV-B-related lineages. Twenty-seven capsid protein sequences from 12 pediatric samples had best BLASTp matches to references annotated as HAdV-B3 ( n = 23) or HAdV-B7 ( n = 4). These findings provide sequence evidence for HAdV-B-related sequence signals in clinically selected pediatric BALF samples and support further investigation using targeted assays and genome sequencing.

papers.title: Identification and functional characterization of ASCC2 as a diagnostic biomarker and immune regulatory hub in Kawasaki disease.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Kawasaki disease (KD) is an acute systemic vasculitis in children, yet its molecular mechanisms remain incompletely understood. This study aimed to identify downregulated candidate diagnostic biomarkers and subsequently investigate the potential functional relevance of a prioritized candidate gene in KD. METHODS: Bulk transcriptomic data from GSE73461 were used for biomarker discovery and model development, while GSE68004 was used for independent external validation. Single-cell RNA sequencing data from GSE168732 were further analyzed to investigate the cellular and regulatory characteristics of the identified genes. Differential expression analysis, WGCNA, machine learning algorithms, CellChat, and scTenifold-based perturbation analysis were performed. Functional investigation of the prioritized candidate ASCC2 was performed in TNF-α-stimulated HUVECs using siRNA-mediated knockdown. RESULTS: Three consistently downregulated genes (EPB42, RUNDC3A, and ASCC2) were identified as candidate diagnostic biomarkers for KD. The three-gene model achieved an AUC of 0.903 in the discovery cohort and 0.948 in the independent GSE68004 cohort. In clinically relevant febrile controls, the model showed moderate discrimination between KD and human adenovirus infection (AUC = 0.830) and between KD and Group A streptococcal infection (AUC = 0.769). Among the three genes, ASCC2 was prioritized for further biological investigation based on its associations with immune-cell populations. Single-cell analyses revealed altered intercellular communication and cell-type-specific ASCC2 expression patterns, while in silico perturbation analysis implicated ASCC2 in NK-cell cytotoxicity and cell-cycle-related regulatory programs. In TNF-α-stimulated HUVECs, ASCC2 knockdown reduced CCK-8-derived metabolic activity and induced G0/G1 cell-cycle arrest. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings identify EPB42, RUNDC3A, and ASCC2 as a reproducible molecular signature associated with KD. The signature robustly discriminated KD from healthy controls and showed moderate discriminatory ability against clinically relevant febrile infections, supporting its potential utility as an adjunctive molecular marker rather than a standalone diagnostic tool. Among these genes, ASCC2 was further investigated as a candidate immune-related regulator through computational and endothelial-cell functional analyses. These findings support the diagnostic potential of the three-gene panel while providing preliminary mechanistic insights into ASCC2 in KD. Key Points • EPB42, RUNDC3A, and ASCC2 were identified as a downregulated molecular signature associated with Kawasaki disease and independently validated in GSE68004. • ASCC2 was prioritized for single-cell and in silico perturbation analyses, which suggested associations with NK-cell cytotoxicity and cell-cycle-related regulatory programs. • ASCC2 depletion in TNF-α-stimulated HUVECs reduced cell viability/metabolic activity and increased G0/G1-phase accumulation under inflammatory conditions.

papers.title: From ward to wastewater: optimising near-source surveillance for microbial targets in hospitals
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hospitals generate wastewater enriched with human-derived microbes, making them strong sites for focused, near-source surveillance of pathogens. We compared in-sewer 24-h composite and passive sampling at two hospital discharge locations and influent sampling at a municipal wastewater treatment plant (WWTP). We also evaluated three extraction workflows to determine how sampling and extraction methods influence detection sensitivity across faecal indicators (HF183, crAssphage) and clinically relevant pathogens (SARS-CoV-2, human adenovirus, Campylobacter jejuni). Across 14 consecutive days, HF183 and crAssphage quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) cycle threshold (Ct) signals were stronger in hospital wastewater than at the WWTP, consistent with greater human faecal input at the near-source sites. crAssphage and human adenovirus were detected with comparable Ct values in passive and liquid samples, whereas the bacterial targets HF183 and C. jejuni were detected less sensitively by passive sampling, particularly at one hospital site. This pattern was consistent with site-specific wastewater composition and flow dynamics affecting membrane retention. SARS-CoV-2 variant sequencing from hospital wastewater resolved five lineages, with the emerging XEC recombinant identified up to 14 days before its detection in municipal wastewater or clinical sequencing. Overall, sampling method, location, and analytical workflow all influenced detection sensitivity, highlighting the need for context-specific method optimisation in near-source wastewater surveillance.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 医院产生富含人源微生物的废水,使其成为集中、近源 监测 病原体的强大场所。我们比较了两个医院出院地点的下水道内 24 小时复合采样和被动采样以及城市污水 治疗 工厂 (WWTP) 的进水采样。我们还评估了三种提取工作流程,以确定采样和提取方法如何影响粪便指标(HF183、crAssphage)和临床相关病原体(SARS-CoV-2、人腺病毒、空肠弯曲菌)的检测灵敏度。连续 14 天,医院废水中的 HF183 和 crAssphage 定量聚合酶链式反应 (qPCR) 循环阈值 (Ct) 信号比污水处理厂更强,这与近源点的人类粪便输入量增加一致。在被动样品和液体样品中检测到的 crAssphage 和 人腺病毒 的 Ct 值相当,而通过被动采样检测到的目标细菌 HF183 和空肠弯曲菌的灵敏度较低,特别是在一家医院站点。这种模式与影响膜保留的特定地点废水成分和流动动力学一致。对医院废水进行的 SARS-CoV-2 变异测序解析了 5 个谱系,新出现的 XEC 重组体在城市废水中检测到或进行临床测序前 14 天就被鉴定出来。总体而言,采样方法、位置和分析工作流程都会影响检测灵敏度,凸显了在近源废水 监测 中针对具体情况进行方法优化的必要性。

papers.title: การศกษายอนหลงการตดเชอไวรสอะดโนในโรงพยาบาลรามาธบด (พ.ศ. 2555-2565): การวเคราะหปจจยเสยงผานวธการตรวจวนจฉย ดวยการเพมปรมาณกรดนวคลอกในหองปฏบตการไวรสวทยา
papers.abstract: Human adenovirus (HAdV) has been identified as a significant causative agent of infection, affecting patients of all age demographics. The present retrospective study was conducted with the objective of investigating the association of risk factors with adenovirus infection. An analysis was conducted on data from the Virology Laboratory, Department of Pathology, Faculty of Medicine, Ramathibodi Hospital, from 2012 to 2022. The study included a total of 46,128 individuals. The study identified 2,348 infections (5.09%), with the highest number of infections (436, 9.86%) recorded in 2013. In particular, the infection rate was found to be higher in children under 12 years. The former group included toddlers (8.46%), preschoolers (9.17%), and school-aged children (6.11%), with the infection rate greather than for the newborn and infant being 3.92%. Correlation analysis was performed Multivariable logistic regression analysis revealed that toddlers (Adjusted OR=2.12, 95% CI=1.74-2.57), preschoolers (Adjusted OR=2.41, 95% CI=1.95-2.97), and school-aged children (Adjusted OR=1.63, 95% CI=1.26-2.12) had a significantly higher risk of adenovirus infection than newborns and young children, respectively. There was no significant difference in infection risk between males and females. The sample with the highest incidence of adenovirus infection was nasal rinse fluid (Adjusted OR=1.82, 95% CI=1.28-2.59), followed by throat swabs (Adjusted OR=1.70, 95% CI=1.25-2.32). The findings reported herein pertain to adenovirus infection in the period preceding the advent of the pandemic caused by the severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS)-coronavirus (CoV-2). The levels were found to be significantly higher than during the post-pandemic period, with an observed increase of 1.93 times (Adjusted OR=1.93, 95% CI=1.52-2.44). These findings have the potential to inform the enhancement of medical and public health preparedness in anticipation of future adenovirus outbreaks, thereby facilitating more effective responses.

papers.title: Mechanistic Digital Model for Real‐Time Monitoring and Optimization of Adenovirus Production
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Adenoviral vectors are a critical vaccine platform, with billions of vaccine doses administered during the COVID‐19 pandemic. In addition, they are promising therapeutics for cancer treatment. To advance their manufacturing, real‐time monitoring of adenovirus production is essential for process optimization, yield improvement, and product quality assurance. However, despite modern bioreactors being equipped with advanced sensors, comprehensive monitoring of viral production in real‐time remains limited. In this work, we investigated potential indicators of the cell density effect (CDE), which imposes a trade‐off between high cell density and specific productivity, thereby hindering process optimization. Glucose availability (expressed as glucose per cell) at time of infection was identified as the most effective proxy indicator. We developed an age‐structured mechanistic model linking measurable process variables, such as glucose and viable cell density to viral production while capturing the CDE. This framework enables the prediction of viral particle titers in both batch and fed‐batch operation modes, achieving an RMSE of 0.39 in log 10 IVP/mL for infectious viral particles and 0.20 in log 10 VP/mL for total viral particles, corresponding to approximately 2.6 and 2.0 times the measurement standard deviation of the respective assays. The proposed model and calibration method lay the foundation for a digital twin of adenovirus production, bridging real‐time sensing with model‐based simulation to support adaptive control and accelerate the transition toward Biopharma 4.0.

papers.title_zh: 用于实时监测和优化腺病毒生产的机械数字模型
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Adenoviral vectors are a critical vaccine platform, with billions of vaccine doses administered during the COVID‐19 pandemic. In addition, they are promising therapeutics for cancer treatment. To advance their manufacturing, real‐time monitoring of adenovirus production is essential for process optimization, yield improvement, and product quality assurance. However, despite modern bioreactors being equipped with advanced sensors, comprehensive monitoring of viral production in real‐time remains limited. In this work, we investigated potential indicators of the cell density effect (CDE), which imposes a trade‐off between high cell density and specific productivity, thereby hindering process optimization. Glucose availability (expressed as glucose per cell) at time of infection was identified as the most effective proxy indicator. We developed an age‐structured mechanistic model linking measurable process variables, such as glucose and viable cell density to viral production while capturing the CDE. This framework enables the prediction of viral particle titers in both batch and fed‐batch operation modes, achieving an RMSE of 0.39 in log 10 IVP/mL for infectious viral particles and 0.20 in log 10 VP/mL for total viral particles, corresponding to approximately 2.6 and 2.0 times the measurement standard deviation of the respective assays. The proposed model and calibration method lay the foundation for a digital twin of adenovirus production, bridging real‐time sensing with model‐based simulation to support adaptive control and accelerate the transition toward Biopharma 4.0.

papers.title: Respiratory panel detections, inflammatory biomarkers, and length of stay in children hospitalized with acute respiratory tract infections: a retrospective cohort study
papers.abstract: Qualitative respiratory-panel detections and inflammatory markers are often considered together in hospitalized children, but neither identifies the cause of illness on its own. We examined associations between panel detections and routinely recorded biomarkers, radiographic findings, and length of stay (LOS). This retrospective study included children aged ≤ 18 years hospitalized with acute respiratory tract infections at Hangzhou Children’s Hospital, China, between 5 January 2023 and 17 June 2025. A 13-target pharyngeal-swab assay was summarized as 11 analytical groups. Primary outcomes were high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP) ≥20 mg/L, procalcitonin (PCT) ≥0.5 ng/mL, and LOS ≥ 7 days. Complete-case logistic models adjusted for age group, sex, testing year, and season. Sensitivity analyses assessed continuous biomarkers, multiple-target detections, recorded severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) positivity, and sampling within 24 or 48 hours of admission using source records and chart-reviewed intervals. Among 6093 children, 2076 were panel-negative, 3343 had single-target detection, and 674 had multiple-target detection. Compared with panel-negative children, human adenovirus detection was associated with hsCRP ≥ 20 mg/L (adjusted odds ratio [aOR], 2.19; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.63–2.96) and PCT ≥ 0.5 ng/mL (aOR, 1.93; 95% CI, 1.34–2.77). Mycoplasma pneumoniae (MP) detection was associated with LOS ≥ 7 days (aOR, 2.57; 95% CI, 1.99–3.31) and lower odds of PCT ≥ 0.5 ng/mL (aOR, 0.22; 95% CI, 0.13–0.37). The MP–LOS aORs were 2.50 (1.82–3.44) and 2.76 (2.12–3.59) in the 24-hour and 48-hour subsets. Multiple-target detection was also associated with LOS ≥ 7 days (aOR, 2.21; 95% CI, 1.73–2.82). Detection groups differed in recorded biomarker and hospitalization measures. Early-sampling restrictions supported the persistence of the MP–LOS association but did not establish causation. Unmeasured bacterial infection, treatment, illness severity, and clinical selection preclude pathogen-causal or prognostic interpretation.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the associations between respiratory-panel detections and inflammatory biomarkers in children hospitalized with acute respiratory tract infections, as neither method alone can definitively identify the cause of illness.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This retrospective cohort study analyzed data from children aged ≤ 18 years hospitalized with acute respiratory tract infections at Hangzhou Children’s Hospital, China, between 5 January 2023 and 17 June 2025. The study included 6093 children, categorized into panel-negative, single-target detection, and multiple-target detection groups.
analysis.methods: A 13-target pharyngeal-swab assay was used to summarize data into 11 analytical groups. Complete-case logistic models were adjusted for age group, sex, testing year, and season. Sensitivity analyses assessed continuous biomarkers, multiple-target detections, and sampling intervals.
analysis.main_results: Human adenovirus detection was associated with hsCRP ≥ 20 mg/L (adjusted odds ratio [aOR], 2.19; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.63–2.96) and PCT ≥ 0.5 ng/mL (aOR, 1.93; 95% CI, 1.34–2.77). analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that human adenovirus and Mycoplasma pneumoniae detections are linked to specific inflammatory biomarkers and prolonged hospital stays, highlighting potential clinical correlations.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results may inform the development of targeted diagnostic strategies and improve understanding of disease severity in children with respiratory infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's design limitations include unmeasured bacterial infections, treatment effects, and clinical selection biases, which preclude definitive causal or prognostic interpretations. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these factors.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study investigated the associations between respiratory-panel detections and inflammatory biomarkers in children hospitalized with acute respiratory tract infections. The study included 6093 children from Hangzhou Children’s Hospital, China, between 2023 and 2025. A 13-target pharyngeal-swab assay was used to classify infections into different groups. Results showed that human adenovirus detection was linked to elevated hsCRP and PCT levels, while Mycoplasma pneumoniae detection was associated with prolonged hospital stays and lower PCT odds. The findings suggest potential clinical correlations between these pathogens and inflammatory markers. However, limitations such as unmeasured bacterial infections and treatment effects prevent causal or prognostic conclusions. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these constraints.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨因急性呼吸道感染住院的儿童的呼吸检测和炎症生物标志物之间的关联,因为单独使用这两种方法都无法明确确定病因。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性 队列研究 研究分析了 2023 年 1 月 5 日至 2025 年 6 月 17 日期间在中国杭州儿童医院因急性呼吸道感染住院的 ≤ 18 岁儿童的数据。该研究包括 6093 名儿童,分为面板阴性组、单目标检测组和多目标检测组。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 13 目标咽拭子检测将数据总结为 11 个分析组。针对年龄组、性别、测试年份和季节对完整病例逻辑模型进行了调整。敏感性分析评估了连续生物标志物、多目标检测和采样间隔。
elements_zh.main_results: Human adenovirus detection was associated with hsCRP ≥ 20 mg/L (adjusted odds ratio [aOR], 2.19; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.63–2.96) and PCT ≥ 0.5 ng/mL (aOR, 1.93; 95% CI, 1.34–2.77). Mycoplasma pneumoniae detection was associated with LOS ≥ 7 days (aOR, 2.57; 95% CI, 1.99–3.31) and lower odds of PCT ≥ 0.5 ng/mL (aOR, 0.22; 95% CI, 0.13–0.37).
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,人腺病毒 和肺炎支原体检测与特定炎症生物标志物和住院时间延长有关,突出了潜在的临床相关性。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the associations between respiratory-panel detections and inflammatory biomarkers in children hospitalized with acute respiratory tract infections, as neither method alone can definitively identify the cause of illness.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This retrospective cohort study analyzed data from children aged ≤ 18 years hospitalized with acute respiratory tract infections at Hangzhou Children’s Hospital, China, between 5 January 2023 and 17 June 2025. The study included 6093 children, categorized into panel-negative, single-target detection, and multiple-target detection groups.
analysis_en.methods: A 13-target pharyngeal-swab assay was used to summarize data into 11 analytical groups. Complete-case logistic models were adjusted for age group, sex, testing year, and season. Sensitivity analyses assessed continuous biomarkers, multiple-target detections, and sampling intervals.
analysis_en.main_results: Human adenovirus detection was associated with hsCRP ≥ 20 mg/L (adjusted odds ratio [aOR], 2.19; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.63–2.96) and PCT ≥ 0.5 ng/mL (aOR, 1.93; 95% CI, 1.34–2.77). Mycoplasma pneumoniae detection was associated with LOS ≥ 7 days (aOR, 2.57; 95% CI, 1.99–3.31) and lower odds of PCT ≥ 0.5 ng/mL (aOR, 0.22; 95% CI, 0.13–0.37).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that human adenovirus and Mycoplasma pneumoniae detections are linked to specific inflammatory biomarkers and prolonged hospital stays, highlighting potential clinical correlations.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results may inform the development of targeted diagnostic strategies and improve understanding of disease severity in children with respiratory infections.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's design limitations include unmeasured bacterial infections, treatment effects, and clinical selection biases, which preclude definitive causal or prognostic interpretations. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these factors.

papers.title_zh: 因急性呼吸道感染住院的儿童的呼吸道检测、炎症生物标志物和住院时间:一项回顾性 队列研究 研究
papers.source_body_en: Qualitative respiratory-panel detections and inflammatory markers are often considered together in hospitalized children, but neither identifies the cause of illness on its own. We examined associations between panel detections and routinely recorded biomarkers, radiographic findings, and length of stay (LOS). This retrospective study included children aged ≤ 18 years hospitalized with acute respiratory tract infections at Hangzhou Children’s Hospital, China, between 5 January 2023 and 17 June 2025. A 13-target pharyngeal-swab assay was summarized as 11 analytical groups. Primary outcomes were high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP) ≥20 mg/L, procalcitonin (PCT) ≥0.5 ng/mL, and LOS ≥ 7 days. Complete-case logistic models adjusted for age group, sex, testing year, and season. Sensitivity analyses assessed continuous biomarkers, multiple-target detections, recorded severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) positivity, and sampling within 24 or 48 hours of admission using source records and chart-reviewed intervals. Among 6093 children, 2076 were panel-negative, 3343 had single-target detection, and 674 had multiple-target detection. Compared with panel-negative children, human adenovirus detection was associated with hsCRP ≥ 20 mg/L (adjusted odds ratio [aOR], 2.19; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.63–2.96) and PCT ≥ 0.5 ng/mL (aOR, 1.93; 95% CI, 1.34–2.77). Mycoplasma pneumoniae (MP) detection was associated with LOS ≥ 7 days (aOR, 2.57; 95% CI, 1.99–3.31) and lower odds of PCT ≥ 0.5 ng/mL (aOR, 0.22; 95% CI, 0.13–0.37). The MP–LOS aORs were 2.50 (1.82–3.44) and 2.76 (2.12–3.59) in the 24-hour and 48-hour subsets. Multiple-target detection was also associated with LOS ≥ 7 days (aOR, 2.21; 95% CI, 1.73–2.82). Detection groups differed in recorded biomarker and hospitalization measures. Early-sampling restrictions supported the persistence of the MP–LOS association but did not establish causation. Unmeasured bacterial infection, treatment, illness severity, and clinical selection preclude pathogen-causal or prognostic interpretation.
papers.abstract_zh: 定性呼吸道检测试剂盒检测和炎症标志物常被一起用于住院儿童,但单独使用都不能确定疾病的病因。我们研究了检测试剂盒检测结果与常规记录的生物标志物、影像学发现以及住院天数(LOS)之间的关联。这项回顾性研究包括了2023年1月5日至2025年6月17日期间在中国杭州儿童医院因急性呼吸道感染住院的年龄≤18岁的儿童。一个13项目标的咽拭子检测被总结为11个分析组。主要结局是高灵敏度C反应蛋白(hsCRP)≥20 mg/L、降钙素原(PCT)≥0.5 ng/mL以及住院天数≥7天。完全案例的逻辑回归模型调整了年龄组、性别、检测年份和季节。敏感性分析评估了连续生物标志物、多目标检测、记录的严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2(SARS-CoV-2)阳性以及入院24或48小时内采样的情况。在6093名儿童中,2076名检测为阴性,3343名有单目标检测,674名有多目标检测。与检测阴性的儿童相比,人腺病毒检测与hsCRP≥20 mg/L(调整后比值比[aOR]为2.19;95%置信区间[CI]为1.63–2.96)和PCT≥0.5 ng/mL(aOR为1.93;95% CI为1.34–2.77)相关。肺炎支原体(MP)检测与LOS≥7天(aOR为2.57;95% CI为1.99–3.31)以及较低的PCT≥0.5 ng/mL发生几率(aOR为0.22;95% CI为0.13–0.37)相关。在24小时和48小时子集中的MP–LOS aOR分别为2.50(1.82–3.44)和2.76(2.12–3.59)。多目标检测也与LOS≥7天相关(aOR为2.21;95% CI为1.73–2.82)。检测组在记录的生物标志物和住院指标上存在差异。早期采样限制支持了MP与LOS之间的关联,但并未确立因果关系。未测量的细菌感染、治疗、疾病严重程度和临床选择排除了病原体因果或预后解释的可能。

papers.title: Freshwater Microbiomes Shape Viral Inactivation in Continuous Cultures
papers.abstract: The high stability of enteric viruses in freshwater increases their risk of waterborne transmission. In aquatic environments, bacteria are known to enhance viral removal and inactivation. However, the differences in viral inactivation across freshwater ecosystems and the influence of community diversity on this process remains poorly understood. Here, we used dilution-to-extinction to generate 64 distinct freshwater communities from three lakes and three aquifers. After establishing freshwater communities in chemostat cultures, each community was challenged with two viruses, coxsackievirus B5 and human adenovirus 2. Both viruses were inactivated more rapidly in lake-derived than in groundwater-derived communities, and adenovirus was inactivated faster than coxsackievirus in both freshwater types. Community-level parameters (cell numbers, richness, evenness) were not significant predictors of viral inactivation. In contrast, differential abundance analyses identified bacterial OTUs associated with inactivation: Acidovorax sp. were associated across sources and Brevundimonas sp., Sphingopyxis sp., and Hydrogenophaga sp. showed source-specific associations. Together, these findings provide new insights into the ecological drivers of viral stability and suggest that viral inactivation may depend more strongly on specific microbial taxa and their ecological context than on overall community diversity. Identifying these associations improves our understanding of the factors governing viral persistence in freshwater environments.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查淡水生态系统如何影响病毒失活,特别关注微生物群落在降低水中肠道病毒稳定性方面的作用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用连续恒化器培养来模拟淡水环境,从三个湖泊和三个含水层生成 64 个不同的群落。然后,每个社区都受到两种病毒的挑战:柯萨奇病毒 B5 和 人腺病毒 2。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员采用稀释至灭绝的方法来创建淡水群落,并使用差异丰度分析来识别与病毒失活相关的细菌 OTU。
elements_zh.main_results: 在湖泊来源和地下水来源的群落中,人腺病毒 2 的灭活速度比柯萨奇病毒 B5 更快。然而,细胞数量、丰富度和均匀度等群落水平参数并不是病毒失活的重要预测因素。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,淡水环境中的病毒失活更受特定微生物类群的影响,而不是整体群落多样性的影响,这为影响病毒稳定性的生态因素提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可以为水传播病毒控制策略提供信息,并强调微生物群落组成在确定淡水系统中病毒持久性方面的重要性。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate how freshwater ecosystems influence viral inactivation, particularly focusing on the role of microbial communities in reducing the stability of enteric viruses in water.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study used continuous chemostat cultures to simulate freshwater environments, generating 64 distinct communities from three lakes and three aquifers. Each community was then challenged with two viruses, coxsackievirus B5 and human adenovirus 2.
analysis_en.methods: The researchers employed dilution-to-extinction to create freshwater communities and used differential abundance analyses to identify bacterial OTUs associated with viral inactivation.
analysis_en.main_results: Human adenovirus 2 was inactivated more rapidly than coxsackievirus B5 in both lake-derived and groundwater-derived communities. However, community-level parameters like cell numbers, richness, and evenness were not significant predictors of viral inactivation.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that viral inactivation in freshwater environments is more strongly influenced by specific microbial taxa rather than overall community diversity, offering new insights into ecological factors affecting viral stability.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results can inform strategies for waterborne virus control and highlight the importance of microbial community composition in determining viral persistence in freshwater systems.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's results are based on in vitro chemostat cultures, which may not fully represent natural aquatic environments. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the controlled experimental setting.

papers.title_zh: 淡水微生物组在连续培养中影响病毒失活
papers.source_body_en: The high stability of enteric viruses in freshwater increases their risk of waterborne transmission. In aquatic environments, bacteria are known to enhance viral removal and inactivation. However, the differences in viral inactivation across freshwater ecosystems and the influence of community diversity on this process remains poorly understood. Here, we used dilution-to-extinction to generate 64 distinct freshwater communities from three lakes and three aquifers. After establishing freshwater communities in chemostat cultures, each community was challenged with two viruses, coxsackievirus B5 and human adenovirus 2. Both viruses were inactivated more rapidly in lake-derived than in groundwater-derived communities, and adenovirus was inactivated faster than coxsackievirus in both freshwater types. Community-level parameters (cell numbers, richness, evenness) were not significant predictors of viral inactivation. In contrast, differential abundance analyses identified bacterial OTUs associated with inactivation: Acidovorax sp. were associated across sources and Brevundimonas sp., Sphingopyxis sp., and Hydrogenophaga sp. showed source-specific associations. Together, these findings provide new insights into the ecological drivers of viral stability and suggest that viral inactivation may depend more strongly on specific microbial taxa and their ecological context than on overall community diversity. Identifying these associations improves our understanding of the factors governing viral persistence in freshwater environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 肠道病毒在淡水中的高稳定性增加了其水传播 传播 的风险。在水生环境中,已知细菌可以增强病毒的清除和灭活作用。然而,淡水生态系统中病毒灭活的差异以及群落多样性对此过程的影响仍然知之甚少。在这里,我们利用稀释至灭绝的方法从三个湖泊和三个含水层生成了 64 个不同的淡水群落。在恒化培养物中建立淡水群落后,每个群落都受到两种病毒的攻击,即柯萨奇病毒 B5 和 人腺病毒 2。这两种病毒在湖泊来源的群落中比在地下水来源的群落中失活更快,并且在两种淡水类型中,腺病毒比柯萨奇病毒失活更快。群落水平参数(细胞数量、丰富度、均匀度)并不是病毒失活的显着预测因素。相比之下,差异丰度分析确定了与失活相关的细菌 OTU:Acidovorax sp。跨来源与短波单胞菌属 (Brevundimonas sp.)、鞘氨醇单胞菌属 (Sphingopyxis sp.) 和氢噬菌属 (Hydrogenophaga sp.) 相关。显示出特定来源的关联。总之,这些发现为病毒稳定性的生态驱动因素提供了新的见解,并表明病毒失活可能更依赖于特定的微生物类群及其生态环境,而不是整体群落多样性。识别这些关联可以提高我们对控制淡水环境中病毒持久性的因素的理解。

and After a Severe HAdV-7 Military Outbreak in Finland in 2024 【字体: 大 中 小 】 时间:2026年10月03日 来源:Influenza and Other Respiratory Viruses 3.9 编辑推荐: 摘要专业翻译 背景 2024年,芬兰军事驻地发生了一起由人腺病毒7d型(HAdV-7)引起的严重暴发疫情。为支持疫情控制,研究实施了分子分型。本研究旨在通过回顾性监测确定2013—2023年间芬兰驻地循环的腺病毒型别,并回顾既往发现,以更好地理解促成2024年 下载【非酒精性脂肪性肝炎(NASH)明星治疗靶点】,获取针对NASH的药物开发的最新进展。 为了促进科学的传播,生物通采集了这篇文章 订阅BioHot点这里解锁原文链接推送! “畅读会员”点此登录查看原文链接 ORIGINAL ARTICLE Open Access 摘要专业翻译 背景 2024年,芬兰军事驻地发生了一起由人腺病毒7d型(HAdV-7)引起的严重暴发疫情。为支持疫情控制,研究实施了分子分型。本研究旨在通过回顾性监测确定2013—2023年间芬兰驻地循环的腺病毒型别,并回顾既往发现,以更好地理解促成2024年暴发的因素。 方法 通过常规监测(2013—2023年)和强化监测(2024—2025年)收集的腺病毒阳性呼吸道样本,采用针对3、4、7、11、14、16和21型别的型特异性PCR检测进行分型。对11份选定样本进行了全基因组测序。对2023年末感染HAdV-7的应征士兵开展了指示病例访谈。 结果 2013—2023年间,在497份已分型样本中,HAdV-4最为常见(n = 446;89.7%),其次为HAdV-3(n = 25;5%)。检测到的其他型别包括HAdV-21(n = 11;2.2%)、HAdV-7(n = 6;1.2%)和HAdV-11(n = 1;0.2%)。HAdV-4在2013—2017年间占主导地位,HAdV-3则在2018—2019年间占优。2024年2月至2025年6月期间,共对1692份腺病毒阳性呼吸道样本进行了分型。检测到的腺病毒型别为HAdV-4(n = 1133;67%)、HAdV-7(n = 440;26%)、HAdV-4与HAdV-7共检出(n = 70;4.1%)以及HAdV-14(n = 1;0.1%)。流行病学调查和全基因组测序数据揭示,与2024年暴发相关的腺病毒(HAdV-7d)早在2023年就已在芬兰驻地中循环。 结论 2024年暴发的严重程度可能反映了HAdV-7在芬兰既往循环有限。尽管HAdV-7在2025年仍在应征士兵中持续循环,但疫情严重程度有所缓解,这可能归因于在主动监测指导下实施的有效预防措施。 论文解读 索取CAR-T 细胞免疫疗法最新资料领 取 一、研究背景与目的 人腺病毒(Human Adenovirus,HAdV)属于腺病毒科(Adenoviridae)乳腺腺病毒属(Mastadenovirus),可分为七个种(A–G),包含51种公认血清型及超过100种基因型。不同型别与特定的临床表现相关:3、4、7、14和21型主要引起呼吸道感染,8、19和37型与结膜炎相关,40和41型则导致胃肠道感染。腺病毒在拥挤环境中易引发暴发,大学校园、托儿所、监狱、执法培训中心及养老机构均有相关疫情记录,而军事驻地是最常被报道的暴发场所之一,涉及型别主要为4、7、14和21型。 芬兰法律规定18至60岁男性公民有义务参加国防军事服务,女性可自愿申请。芬兰各军事驻地每年均发生呼吸道病毒暴发,多个驻地参与由芬兰卫生与福利研究所(THL)协调的国家呼吸道病毒监测项目。腺病毒暴发通常在每年2至3月出现,恰逢1月新兵入伍之后。2024年2月至6月,芬兰发生了一起异常严重的腺病毒7d型(HAdV-7)暴发,主要影响军事应征士兵及其密切接触者。暴发期间129名腺病毒感染者住院,30人入住重症监护室(ICU),10人需要体外膜肺氧合(ECMO)治疗,另有6例平民死亡。住院患者中75人(58%)为应征士兵,54人(42%)为平民。 本研究旨在通过实验室分析确定2013至2023年间芬兰驻地循环的腺病毒型别,并与此前已报道的腺病毒循环情况进行比较,以更好地理解促成2024年严重暴发的流行病学因素。此外,研究还试图表征暴发后检测到的腺病毒型别,并评估腺病毒7型是否继续在芬兰驻地环境中循环。 二、研究设计与方法 研究人员共分析了两组样本。第一组为2013至2023年间作为芬兰国家流感和呼吸道病毒常规监测一部分从驻地采集的2580份呼吸道样本,参与驻地数量介于6至23个单位之间,样本采集自符合急性呼吸道感染(ARI)或流感样疾病(ILI)世界卫生组织(WHO)病例定义的应征士兵,样本类型包括鼻咽拭子、鼻咽抽吸物、支气管肺泡灌洗液和痰液。第二组为2024年2月启动并持续至2025年的强化腺病毒监测期间采集的1891份腺病毒核酸初筛阳性呼吸道样本,来自全国5个临床实验室,覆盖18个驻地的芬兰应征士兵。 核酸提取采用Chemagic Viral DNA/RNA 300试剂盒及QIAGEN RNeasy Mini试剂盒完成。腺病毒核酸检测使用针对51种HAdV原型株的探针法PCR检测。分子分型采用针对3、4、7、11、14、16和21型别的型特异性探针法实时PCR检测组合。全基因组测序使用Illumina呼吸道病毒富集试剂盒(杂交捕获方法),在Illumina MiSeq平台上完成测序。序列分析流程包括Kraken 2进行病毒读段分类提取、MEGAHit进行重叠群组装、Bowtie 2进行参考序列比对映射、Samtools进行排序和共有序列生成。系统发育分析使用MAFFT进行序列比对,IQ-TREE以最大似然法(ML)结合HKY+F+I模型和1000次超快自举(UFBoot)重复构建进化树,iTOL用于树的可视化,MEGA12计算配对距离。数据分析使用R 4.5.0版本,同一来源个体的重复样本均被排除以保证样本独立性。 三、研究结果 3.1 2013–2023年呼吸道病毒监测结果 在2580份初筛样本中,503份(19.5%)检出腺病毒核酸。研究期间腺病毒阳性样本的月均数介于0.2至10.4之间,3月为阳性样本月均数最高的月份。2020年5月至2023年1月间有33个月未收集到腺病毒阳性样本,系COVID-19大流行扰乱了呼吸道病毒监测所致。在497份来自应征士兵的腺病毒阳性样本中,HAdV-4最为常见,检出446份(89.7%);其次为HAdV-3(25份,5%)、HAdV-21(11份,2.2%)、HAdV-7(6份,1.2%)和HAdV-11(1份,0.2%),另有8份(1.6%)型别未确定。型别分布存在明显年度差异:2013至2017年间HAdV-4占主导地位,2018和2019年仅检出HAdV-3,2021至2022年受疫情影响未在636份样本中检出腺病毒。2023年HAdV-7成为最常见型别,所有检出均集中在8月至11月。 3.2 2024年2月至2025年6月强化监测结果 在1692份有效样本中,HAdV-7检出440份(26%),HAdV-4检出1133份(67%),70份(4.1%)样本同时检出两种型别(共检出),其中大部分发生在2024年秋季,另有1份(0.1%)检出HAdV-14,48份(2.8%)型别未确定。2024年春季(2024年第1–25周)HAdV-7占主导地位;2024年秋季(第28–51周)为过渡期,两种病毒型别共同循环;2025年春季(第1–25周)转为HAdV-4主导。2024年春季腺病毒病例分布于全国12个驻地,秋季在大多数驻地再次增加。2025年春季所有采样超过10份的驻地均观察到腺病毒病例,HAdV-4为所有驻地最常见型别,但两个驻地观察到散发性HAdV-7病例。 3.3 系统发育分析结果 研究人员对2023年末采集的两份HAdV-7阳性样本(PX734071和PX778751)进行了全基因组测序。系统发育分析显示,与2024年芬兰暴发相关的参考序列(PQ600596和PQ600589)及本研究产生的序列在约35 kb基因组范围内具有100%的配对核苷酸一致性。与全球已发表参考株相比,与2023年英格兰检出序列(PX491659)的相似性最高(全基因组核苷酸一致性>99.997%),与2025年英格兰报道的毒株(PX491651和PX491691)以及2023年美国校园监测检出的序列(PP591776)也具有相似水平的一致性。暴发序列还与2019年中国儿童医院暴发毒株(MW815977)及2018年美国大学校园毒株(MN307146和PP591776)紧密聚类,三者与暴发序列的核苷酸一致性均>99.99%。此外,研究人员对2013至2017年间采集的9份HAdV-4样本进行了测序,比较分析揭示三个不同聚类,提示这些HAdV-4毒株为独立引入而非在芬兰驻地环境中持续循环。 3.4 指示病例访谈结果 研究人员对2023年夏末和秋季检出的6例HAdV-7病例中的5例进行了追溯访谈。所有受访者均报告高热伴多种呼吸道症状(如咳嗽、咽痛),部分伴有胃肠道症状。多数受访者表示同一 barracks 房间或驻地其他区域同期有数名其他应征士兵出现类似呼吸道感染症状。这些士兵均无需住院治疗,但部分需要卧床休息数日。 四、讨论与结论 历史证据表明HAdV-7在2023年之前就曾在芬兰驻地环境中循环:1960至1970年代国家公共卫生研究所(THL前身)的档案样本中即有多份HAdV-7阳性记录,部分来自驻地医院,具体年份包括1969–1972年、1975年和1977年。1962年赫尔辛基大学眼科医院曾报道HAdV-7暴发,1967至1968年间HAdV-7也在重症腺病毒肺炎患儿中被报道。然而,病毒重新引入芬兰驻地的来源尚不明确,指示病例访谈中未提及发病前有出国旅行史或与外国平民/军人的接触史。 2008至2012年及2013至2023年的分子分型数据显示,HAdV-4一直是芬兰驻地暴发的主要腺病毒型别,某些年份(2010、2018、2019年)HAdV-3成为主导型别。2010年HAdV-3也是平民人群中最常检出的型别,提示军地循环存在关联。2024年严重暴发及后续强化监测中也观察到类似模式,HAdV-7病例在普通人群和驻地环境中同时出现。 2023年首次在芬兰驻地检出HAdV-7,最早病例出现在8月下旬,当年在三个驻地观察到HAdV-7且为该年度最常见型别。由于2023年驻地监测参与度低,仅8份腺病毒阳性样本完成分型,HAdV-7当时的循环广度未知。流行病学数据和系统发育分析表明,与2024年严重暴发相关的HAdV-7d型在2023年末已存在于芬兰驻地。2023年秋季应征士兵临床表现较轻的原因尚不明确,可能因为感染发生率未达到严重结局出现的阈值,剂量-效应关系也可能参与了2023至2024年间疾病严重程度的增加。 2024年秋季共检出样本中HAdV-7与HAdV-4同时存在,研究人员指出难以区分这是既往感染的基因组残留、亚临床感染还是新的临床相关HAdV-7感染,因为腺病毒核酸可在鼻咽分泌物中持续存在超过6个月。 2024年春季芬兰驻地实施了一系列非药物干预措施,包括加强手部卫生(强调用肥皂和水洗手)、推广咳嗽礼仪、对症状个体进行隔离、对受影响单位实施分组管理、加强环境清洁消毒,以及在特定高风险情境(如巴士运送)中强制佩戴外科口罩。基于PCR的分子分型快速周转时间使得在观察到HAdV-7病例的驻地能够及早实施干预措施。尽管这些措施的有效性未经科学评估,但参与的流行病学家和临床医生观察认为这些干预有助于降低芬兰驻地HAdV-7相关疾病负担。 HAdV-7重新引入驻地环境引发了关于疫苗接种必要性的讨论。美军目前使用的腺病毒疫苗可同时提供针对HAdV-4和HAdV-7的保护。在芬兰考虑使用该疫苗需确保未接种疫苗的应征士兵或其密切接触者免受活疫苗(非减毒)接种者排毒暴露的风险,因为芬兰男性兵役为强制性的,但疫苗接种并非强制。 研究存在若干局限性:2013至2023年间部分年份样本量有限(尤其COVID-19大流行期间);驻地参与监测的程度不一可能影响代表性;部分临床实验室初报腺病毒阳性的样本无法完成分子分析(可能涉及采集、运输或储存问题);分子分型无法区分活动性感染与既往感染的残余病毒DNA;2024–2025年强化监测期间部分样本缺乏驻地归属和军事状态的完整元数据。 研究结论:2024年腺病毒暴发的严重程度可能归因于该腺病毒型别至少在2008年以来未在芬兰驻地循环。腺病毒7d型被引入缺乏对该型别免疫的人群,可能促成了原本健康的应征士兵中出现较多住院病例。芬兰驻地在2024年严重暴发期间实施了非药物预防策略并持续维持。在军事环境中部署这些方法比平民环境更为直接,但此类措施会干扰军事训练。利用分子分型的持续监测被用于将预防措施定向部署到最需要的驻地,以平衡应征士兵的健康保障与有效训练计划的维持。 Before and After a Severe HAdV-7 Military Outbreak in Finland in 2024 【字体: 大 中 小 】 时间:2026年10月03日 来源:Influenza and Other Respiratory Viruses 3.9 编辑推荐: 摘要专业翻译 背景 2024年,芬兰军事驻地发生了一起由人腺病毒7d型(HAdV-7)引起的严重暴发疫情。为支持疫情控制,研究实施了分子分型。本研究旨在通过回顾性监测确定2013—2023年间芬兰驻地循环的腺病毒型别,并回顾既往发现,以更好地理解促成2024年 下载【非酒精性脂肪性肝炎(NASH)明星治疗靶点】,获取针对NASH的药物开发的最新进展。 为了促进科学的传播,生物通采集了这篇文章 订阅BioHot点这里解锁原文链接推送! “畅读会员”点此登录查看原文链接 ORIGINAL ARTICLE Open Access 摘要专业翻译 背景 2024年,芬兰军事驻地发生了一起由人腺病毒7d型(HAdV-7)引起的严重暴发疫情。为支持疫情控制,研究实施了分子分型。本研究旨在通过回顾性监测确定2013—2023年间芬兰驻地循环的腺病毒型别,并回顾既往发现,以更好地理解促成2024年暴发的因素。 方法 通过常规监测(2013—2023年)和强化监测(2024—2025年)收集的腺病毒阳性呼吸道样本,采用针对3、4、7、11、14、16和21型别的型特异性PCR检测进行分型。对11份选定样本进行了全基因组测序。对2023年末感染HAdV-7的应征士兵开展了指示病例访谈。 结果 2013—2023年间,在497份已分型样本中,HAdV-4最为常见(n = 446;89.7%),其次为HAdV-3(n = 25;5%)。检测到的其他型别包括HAdV-21(n = 11;2.2%)、HAdV-7(n = 6;1.2%)和HAdV-11(n = 1;0.2%)。HAdV-4在2013—2017年间占主导地位,HAdV-3则在2018—2019年间占优。2024年2月至2025年6月期间,共对1692份腺病毒阳性呼吸道样本进行了分型。检测到的腺病毒型别为HAdV-4(n = 1133;67%)、HAdV-7(n = 440;26%)、HAdV-4与HAdV-7共检出(n = 70;4.1%)以及HAdV-14(n = 1;0.1%)。流行病学调查和全基因组测序数据揭示,与2024年暴发相关的腺病毒(HAdV-7d)早在2023年就已在芬兰驻地中循环。 结论 2024年暴发的严重程度可能反映了HAdV-7在芬兰既往循环有限。尽管HAdV-7在2025年仍在应征士兵中持续循环,但疫情严重程度有所缓解,这可能归因于在主动监测指导下实施的有效预防措施。 论文解读 索取CAR-T 细胞免疫疗法最新资料领 取 一、研究背景与目的 人腺病毒(Human Adenovirus,HAdV)属于腺病毒科(Adenoviridae)乳腺腺病毒属(Mastadenovirus),可分为七个种(A–G),包含51种公认血清型及超过100种基因型。不同型别与特定的临床表现相关:3、4、7、14和21型主要引起呼吸道感染,8、19和37型与结膜炎相关,40和41型则导致胃肠道感染。腺病毒在拥挤环境中易引发暴发,大学校园、托儿所、监狱、执法培训中心及养老机构均有相关疫情记录,而军事驻地是最常被报道的暴发场所之一,涉及型别主要为4、7、14和21型。 芬兰法律规定18至60岁男性公民有义务参加国防军事服务,女性可自愿申请。芬兰各军事驻地每年均发生呼吸道病毒暴发,多个驻地参与由芬兰卫生与福利研究所(THL)协调的国家呼吸道病毒监测项目。腺病毒暴发通常在每年2至3月出现,恰逢1月新兵入伍之后。2024年2月至6月,芬兰发生了一起异常严重的腺病毒7d型(HAdV-7)暴发,主要影响军事应征士兵及其密切接触者。暴发期间129名腺病毒感染者住院,30人入住重症监护室(ICU),10人需要体外膜肺氧合(ECMO)治疗,另有6例平民死亡。住院患者中75人(58%)为应征士兵,54人(42%)为平民。 本研究旨在通过实验室分析确定2013至2023年间芬兰驻地循环的腺病毒型别,并与此前已报道的腺病毒循环情况进行比较,以更好地理解促成2024年严重暴发的流行病学因素。此外,研究还试图表征暴发后检测到的腺病毒型别,并评估腺病毒7型是否继续在芬兰驻地环境中循环。 二、研究设计与方法 研究人员共分析了两组样本。第一组为2013至2023年间作为芬兰国家流感和呼吸道病毒常规监测一部分从驻地采集的2580份呼吸道样本,参与驻地数量介于6至23个单位之间,样本采集自符合急性呼吸道感染(ARI)或流感样疾病(ILI)世界卫生组织(WHO)病例定义的应征士兵,样本类型包括鼻咽拭子、鼻咽抽吸物、支气管肺泡灌洗液和痰液。第二组为2024年2月启动并持续至2025年的强化腺病毒监测期间采集的1891份腺病毒核酸初筛阳性呼吸道样本,来自全国5个临床实验室,覆盖18个驻地的芬兰应征士兵。 核酸提取采用Chemagic Viral DNA/RNA 300试剂盒及QIAGEN RNeasy Mini试剂盒完成。腺病毒核酸检测使用针对51种HAdV原型株的探针法PCR检测。分子分型采用针对3、4、7、11、14、16和21型别的型特异性探针法实时PCR检测组合。全基因组测序使用Illumina呼吸道病毒富集试剂盒(杂交捕获方法),在Illumina MiSeq平台上完成测序。序列分析流程包括Kraken 2进行病毒读段分类提取、MEGAHit进行重叠群组装、Bowtie 2进行参考序列比对映射、Samtools进行排序和共有序列生成。系统发育分析使用MAFFT进行序列比对,IQ-TREE以最大似然法(ML)结合HKY+F+I模型和1000次超快自举(UFBoot)重复构建进化树,iTOL用于树的可视化,MEGA12计算配对距离。数据分析使用R 4.5.0版本,同一来源个体的重复样本均被排除以保证样本独立性。 三、研究结果 3.1 2013–2023年呼吸道病毒监测结果 在2580份初筛样本中,503份(19.5%)检出腺病毒核酸。研究期间腺病毒阳性样本的月均数介于0.2至10.4之间,3月为阳性样本月均数最高的月份。2020年5月至2023年1月间有33个月未收集到腺病毒阳性样本,系COVID-19大流行扰乱了呼吸道病毒监测所致。在497份来自应征士兵的腺病毒阳性样本中,HAdV-4最为常见,检出446份(89.7%);其次为HAdV-3(25份,5%)、HAdV-21(11份,2.2%)、HAdV-7(6份,1.2%)和HAdV-11(1份,0.2%),另有8份(1.6%)型别未确定。型别分布存在明显年度差异:2013至2017年间HAdV-4占主导地位,2018和2019年仅检出HAdV-3,2021至2022年受疫情影响未在636份样本中检出腺病毒。2023年HAdV-7成为最常见型别,所有检出均集中在8月至11月。 3.2 2024年2月至2025年6月强化监测结果 在1692份有效样本中,HAdV-7检出440份(26%),HAdV-4检出1133份(67%),70份(4.1%)样本同时检出两种型别(共检出),其中大部分发生在2024年秋季,另有1份(0.1%)检出HAdV-14,48份(2.8%)型别未确定。2024年春季(2024年第1–25周)HAdV-7占主导地位;2024年秋季(第28–51周)为过渡期,两种病毒型别共同循环;2025年春季(第1–25周)转为HAdV-4主导。2024年春季腺病毒病例分布于全国12个驻地,秋季在大多数驻地再次增加。2025年春季所有采样超过10份的驻地均观察到腺病毒病例,HAdV-4为所有驻地最常见型别,但两个驻地观察到散发性HAdV-7病例。 3.3 系统发育分析结果 研究人员对2023年末采集的两份HAdV-7阳性样本(PX734071和PX778751)进行了全基因组测序。系统发育分析显示,与2024年芬兰暴发相关的参考序列(PQ600596和PQ600589)及本研究产生的序列在约35 kb基因组范围内具有100%的配对核苷酸一致性。与全球已发表参考株相比,与2023年英格兰检出序列(PX491659)的相似性最高(全基因组核苷酸一致性>99.997%),与2025年英格兰报道的毒株(PX491651和PX491691)以及2023年美国校园监测检出的序列(PP591776)也具有相似水平的一致性。暴发序列还与2019年中国儿童医院暴发毒株(MW815977)及2018年美国大学校园毒株(MN307146和PP591776)紧密聚类,三者与暴发序列的核苷酸一致性均>99.99%。此外,研究人员对2013至2017年间采集的9份HAdV-4样本进行了测序,比较分析揭示三个不同聚类,提示这些HAdV-4毒株为独立引入而非在芬兰驻地环境中持续循环。 3.4 指示病例访谈结果 研究人员对2023年夏末和秋季检出的6例HAdV-7病例中的5例进行了追溯访谈。所有受访者均报告高热伴多种呼吸道症状(如咳嗽、咽痛),部分伴有胃肠道症状。多数受访者表示同一 barracks 房间或驻地其他区域同期有数名其他应征士兵出现类似呼吸道感染症状。这些士兵均无需住院治疗,但部分需要卧床休息数日。 四、讨论与结论 历史证据表明HAdV-7在2023年之前就曾在芬兰驻地环境中循环:1960至1970年代国家公共卫生研究所(THL前身)的档案样本中即有多份HAdV-7阳性记录,部分来自驻地医院,具体年份包括1969–1972年、1975年和1977年。1962年赫尔辛基大学眼科医院曾报道HAdV-7暴发,1967至1968年间HAdV-7也在重症腺病毒肺炎患儿中被报道。然而,病毒重新引入芬兰驻地的来源尚不明确,指示病例访谈中未提及发病前有出国旅行史或与外国平民/军人的接触史。 2008至2012年及2013至2023年的分子分型数据显示,HAdV-4一直是芬兰驻地暴发的主要腺病毒型别,某些年份(2010、2018、2019年)HAdV-3成为主导型别。2010年HAdV-3也是平民人群中最常检出的型别,提示军地循环存在关联。2024年严重暴发及后续强化监测中也观察到类似模式,HAdV-7病例在普通人群和驻地环境中同时出现。 2023年首次在芬兰驻地检出HAdV-7,最早病例出现在8月下旬,当年在三个驻地观察到HAdV-7且为该年度最常见型别。由于2023年驻地监测参与度低,仅8份腺病毒阳性样本完成分型,HAdV-7当时的循环广度未知。流行病学数据和系统发育分析表明,与2024年严重暴发相关的HAdV-7d型在2023年末已存在于芬兰驻地。2023年秋季应征士兵临床表现较轻的原因尚不明确,可能因为感染发生率未达到严重结局出现的阈值,剂量-效应关系也可能参与了2023至2024年间疾病严重程度的增加。 2024年秋季共检出样本中HAdV-7与HAdV-4同时存在,研究人员指出难以区分这是既往感染的基因组残留、亚临床感染还是新的临床相关HAdV-7感染,因为腺病毒核酸可在鼻咽分泌物中持续存在超过6个月。 2024年春季芬兰驻地实施了一系列非药物干预措施,包括加强手部卫生(强调用肥皂和水洗手)、推广咳嗽礼仪、对症状个体进行隔离、对受影响单位实施分组管理、加强环境清洁消毒,以及在特定高风险情境(如巴士运送)中强制佩戴外科口罩。基于PCR的分子分型快速周转时间使得在观察到HAdV-7病例的驻地能够及早实施干预措施。尽管这些措施的有效性未经科学评估,但参与的流行病学家和临床医生观察认为这些干预有助于降低芬兰驻地HAdV-7相关疾病负担。 HAdV-7重新引入驻地环境引发了关于疫苗接种必要性的讨论。美军目前使用的腺病毒疫苗可同时提供针对HAdV-4和HAdV-7的保护。在芬兰考虑使用该疫苗需确保未接种疫苗的应征士兵或其密切接触者免受活疫苗(非减毒)接种者排毒暴露的风险,因为芬兰男性兵役为强制性的,但疫苗接种并非强制。 研究存在若干局限性:2013至2023年间部分年份样本量有限(尤其COVID-19大流行期间);驻地参与监测的程度不一可能影响代表性;部分临床实验室初报腺病毒阳性的样本无法完成分子分析(可能涉及采集、运输或储存问题);分子分型无法区分活动性感染与既往感染的残余病毒DNA;2024–2025年强化监测期间部分样本缺乏驻地归属和军事状态的完整元数据。 研究结论:2024年腺病毒暴发的严重程度可能归因于该腺病毒型别至少在2008年以来未在芬兰驻地循环。腺病毒7d型被引入缺乏对该型别免疫的人群,可能促成了原本健康的应征士兵中出现较多住院病例。芬兰驻地在2024年严重暴发期间实施了非药物预防策略并持续维持。在军事环境中部署这些方法比平民环境更为直接,但此类措施会干扰军事训练。利用分子分型的持续监测被用于将预防措施定向部署到最需要的驻地,以平衡应征士兵的健康保障与有效训练计划的维持。 source_language_evidence.time: 方法 通过常规监测(2013—2023年)和强化监测(2024—2025年)收集的腺病毒阳性呼吸道样本,采用针对3、4、7、11、14、16和21型别的型特异性PCR检测进行分型。对11份选定样本进行了全基因组测序。对2023年末感染HAdV-7的应征士兵开展了指示病例访谈。
